decisions.reason: As a direct extension of the firm's core sports-flooring capability, it is likely to be kept while management tolerates some post-launch uncertainty and waits to see if results rise toward aspiration levels.
A mobile arena floor is a resource-intensive niche product whose likely weak demand and overlap with similar offerings would put it below aspiration and trigger portfolio rationalisation.

Because it appears very similar to another mobile arena system, boundedly rational management would likely redeploy resources from this underperforming and redundant line to stronger core products or new search.
Its prominence on the home page and close fit with hardwood flooring know-how suggest results at least near aspiration, so the firm would be inclined to retain it.
This is a narrow niche within sports surfaces, and if sales have not quickly met aspiration the firm would likely shift effort away from it toward broader flooring lines.
As a low-risk complementary accessory to sports floors, it uses existing capabilities and can be carried even with modest demand because it supports the established business.
